redFirst.basis: `python3 plugins/audit/tests/test_audit_usage.py --selftest` in a throwaway tree at HEAD exited 1 on "AttributeError: module 'usage_ledger' has no attribute 'REPLACE_PASSES_OPEN_FILE'" (read as python), and the task introduces 'REPLACE_PASSES_OPEN_FILE': absent from HEAD's plugins/audit/scripts/usage/usage_ledger.py and present in the working tree's plugins/audit/scripts/usage/usage_ledger.py; a second run with the working tree's implementation copied in exited 0 without that error, its tests reaching their assertions; run without CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, OLDPWD; dependencies linked from the project root, entry by entry as symlinks: node_modules - .cache, .vite, .vite-temp are not linked and a new entry a runner makes beside the links stays in the throwaway, but a write into a linked entry lands in the project's own node_modules and is not watched; no .npmrc to carry or drop

outcome.technical: plugins/audit/scripts/usage/usage_ledger.py: deleted _replace_retrying and REPLACE_RETRIES/REPLACE_RETRY_S; added REPLACE_PASSES_OPEN_FILE = os.name != 'nt'. rewrite_month now decides before the replace: where the platform replaces an open file the descriptor stays held across it (the lock-free-writer carry and _settle that bw2/bw8/bw9/nm1/lf2/lf3 pin on POSIX); where it does not, the tail is drained to its end and closed BEFORE the one _replace_rows call, so the replace never meets the rewrite's own handle and any refusal is another holder's, waited out by _output.while_shared inside _manifest_io.atomic_write_text. The except-PermissionError fallback is gone. Docstring and the lock-wait constant comment restated against SHARING_WAIT_SECONDS. Deviation from an unconditional close, with the reason: a close before the replace on POSIX too drops the held-descriptor carry - mutation M2 below turns bw2, bw8, bw9, bw16, nm1, lf2, lf3 red. tests/test_audit_usage.py: _bw_append_at_refused_retry replaced by _bw_append_at_refused_replace + _bw_refused_backfill - the os.replace seam emulates Windows on every platform (refuses EACCES while any tail open_month returned for the month is still open, counted as own; refuses call 1 as another holder; appends from a thread at the replace that goes through). bw14 pins REPLACE_PASSES_OPEN_FILE=False and asserts code 0, calls==2, own==0, one tail watched, the row survives. New twin bw16 pins True with SHARING_WAIT_SECONDS 0.2 and asserts the seam sees and refuses the held handle (own>=1, own==calls, code!=0). bw2 now skips via _harness.skip where REPLACE_PASSES_OPEN_FILE is false (it was passing on Windows only because the self-spin gave an extra drain - the window rewrite_month's docstring already names). Added import _output. tests/test_usage_ledger.py: new rs1 (one case, the full tests.add clause as its title): Windows reading pinned; 3 emulated foreign refusals -> rewrite True, calls 4, own 0, new rows land; refusals forever with SHARING_WAIT_SECONDS 0.2 -> False, old bytes identical, no .tmp left. nm1 skips where the descriptor is not held; lf6 now reads _output.SHARING_WAIT_SECONDS. Runs: test_audit_usage.py --selftest exit 0 'ALL PASS: 176/176 cases passed'; test_usage_ledger.py --selftest exit 0 '121/121 cases passed'; python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py exit 0 '334/334 files ok, 153 migrated to tests/, 16158 cases'; ruff exit 0; vermin exit 0. Mutations in scratch copies of plugins/audit (scratchpad/mut/M1..M4), both suites run each: M1 close moved back after the replace (try replace; except PermissionError: drain, close, replace) -> bw14 FAIL 'calls=78 own=77 watched=1 count=1 code=0' (the CI shape), bw16 FAIL, rs1 FAIL; M2 close unconditionally (held=False) -> bw2, bw8, bw9, bw16, nm1, lf2, lf3 FAIL; M3 seam's own-handle detector disabled -> bw16 FAIL alone; M4 predicate ignored (always held) -> bw14 FAIL 'calls=75 own=75 count=0 code=1', rs1 FAIL. Line delta, git diff --numstat -- plugins/audit: usage_ledger.py +23 -33 (product net -10), test_audit_usage.py +99 -38, test_usage_ledger.py +109 -16; total 231 insertions, 87 deletions. No file outside the declared files changed.
outcome.descriptive: A usage-ledger month rewrite on Windows lets go of its own handle before the replace, so it no longer spins the shared sharing-denial wait against itself; the shared helper is its only retry.

testsAdded: bw14 holds on both platforms - a row appended while the replace is refused survives it, and the replace is attempted a bounded small number of times (no spin against the rewrite's own handle)
bw16 with the descriptor held across the replace, the same seam sees the rewrite's own handle and refuses it
rs1 a month rewrite whose only holder is another process waits through the shared helper and lands; one whose replace stays refused past the deadline returns False with the old file intact
